name: Website analytics
description: Visits of the sample store website in 2024-2025: sessions, visitors, devices, traffic sources, landing pages, the purchase funnel and countries.

widgets.body: Generated page views of a sample store website, table sample.page_views. A session is a visit of 1-6 pages; a bounce is a session with one page. Click a country in the table at the bottom to filter the dashboard by it. The change is shown against the same period a year earlier.

widgets.title: Sessions
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    countIf(k_cur) AS `Sessions`,
    if(countIf(k_prev) = 0, NULL, round((toFloat64(countIf(k_cur)) - toFloat64(countIf(k_prev))) / toFloat64(countIf(k_prev)) * 100, 1)) AS `Change, %`,
    'vs a year earlier' AS `Compared with`
FROM
(
    SELECT
        session_id,
        any(user_id) AS s_user,
        count() AS s_views,
        any(event_date) BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to) AS k_cur,
        any(event_date) BETWEEN subtractYears(toDate(:date_from), 1) AND subtractYears(toDate(:date_to), 1) AS k_prev
    FROM sample.page_views
    WHERE (:device = 'All' OR device_type = :device)
      AND (:country = 'All' OR country = :country)
    GROUP BY session_id
)

widgets.title: Visitors
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    uniqExactIf(s_user, k_cur) AS `Visitors`,
    if(uniqExactIf(s_user, k_prev) = 0, NULL, round((toFloat64(uniqExactIf(s_user, k_cur)) - toFloat64(uniqExactIf(s_user, k_prev))) / toFloat64(uniqExactIf(s_user, k_prev)) * 100, 1)) AS `Change, %`,
    'vs a year earlier' AS `Compared with`
FROM
(
    SELECT
        session_id,
        any(user_id) AS s_user,
        count() AS s_views,
        any(event_date) BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to) AS k_cur,
        any(event_date) BETWEEN subtractYears(toDate(:date_from), 1) AND subtractYears(toDate(:date_to), 1) AS k_prev
    FROM sample.page_views
    WHERE (:device = 'All' OR device_type = :device)
      AND (:country = 'All' OR country = :country)
    GROUP BY session_id
)

widgets.title: Page views
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    sumIf(s_views, k_cur) AS `Page views`,
    if(sumIf(s_views, k_prev) = 0, NULL, round((toFloat64(sumIf(s_views, k_cur)) - toFloat64(sumIf(s_views, k_prev))) / toFloat64(sumIf(s_views, k_prev)) * 100, 1)) AS `Change, %`,
    'vs a year earlier' AS `Compared with`
FROM
(
    SELECT
        session_id,
        any(user_id) AS s_user,
        count() AS s_views,
        any(event_date) BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to) AS k_cur,
        any(event_date) BETWEEN subtractYears(toDate(:date_from), 1) AND subtractYears(toDate(:date_to), 1) AS k_prev
    FROM sample.page_views
    WHERE (:device = 'All' OR device_type = :device)
      AND (:country = 'All' OR country = :country)
    GROUP BY session_id
)

widgets.title: Bounce rate, %
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    round(countIf(k_cur AND s_views = 1) / greatest(countIf(k_cur), 1) * 100, 1) AS `Bounce rate, %`,
    if(round(countIf(k_prev AND s_views = 1) / greatest(countIf(k_prev), 1) * 100, 1) = 0, NULL, round((toFloat64(round(countIf(k_cur AND s_views = 1) / greatest(countIf(k_cur), 1) * 100, 1)) - toFloat64(round(countIf(k_prev AND s_views = 1) / greatest(countIf(k_prev), 1) * 100, 1))) / toFloat64(round(countIf(k_prev AND s_views = 1) / greatest(countIf(k_prev), 1) * 100, 1)) * 100, 1)) AS `Change, %`,
    'vs a year earlier' AS `Compared with`
FROM
(
    SELECT
        session_id,
        any(user_id) AS s_user,
        count() AS s_views,
        any(event_date) BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to) AS k_cur,
        any(event_date) BETWEEN subtractYears(toDate(:date_from), 1) AND subtractYears(toDate(:date_to), 1) AS k_prev
    FROM sample.page_views
    WHERE (:device = 'All' OR device_type = :device)
      AND (:country = 'All' OR country = :country)
    GROUP BY session_id
)

widgets.title: Sessions by week and device
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    formatDateTime(toMonday(event_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AS `Week`,
    uniqExactIf(session_id, device_type = 'desktop') AS `Desktop`,
    uniqExactIf(session_id, device_type = 'mobile') AS `Mobile`,
    uniqExactIf(session_id, device_type = 'tablet') AS `Tablet`
FROM sample.page_views
WHERE event_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to)
  AND (:device = 'All' OR device_type = :device)
  AND (:country = 'All' OR country = :country)
GROUP BY `Week`
ORDER BY `Week`

widgets.title: Traffic sources
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    if(referrer = '', 'Direct', referrer) AS `Source`,
    count() AS `Sessions`
FROM sample.page_views
WHERE event_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to)
  AND (:device = 'All' OR device_type = :device)
  AND (:country = 'All' OR country = :country)
  AND NOT startsWith(referrer, '/')
GROUP BY `Source`
ORDER BY `Sessions` DESC

widgets.title: Landing pages
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    page_url AS `Landing page`,
    count() AS `Sessions`
FROM sample.page_views
WHERE event_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to)
  AND (:device = 'All' OR device_type = :device)
  AND (:country = 'All' OR country = :country)
  AND NOT startsWith(referrer, '/')
GROUP BY page_url
ORDER BY `Sessions`

widgets.title: Purchase funnel
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    f_step AS `Step`,
    f_sessions AS `Sessions`
FROM
(
    SELECT 1 AS f_order, 'All sessions' AS f_step, uniqExactIf(session_id, 1) AS f_sessions
    FROM sample.page_views
    WHERE event_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to)
      AND (:device = 'All' OR device_type = :device)
      AND (:country = 'All' OR country = :country)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2 AS f_order, 'Viewed products' AS f_step, uniqExactIf(session_id, startsWith(page_url, '/products')) AS f_sessions
    FROM sample.page_views
    WHERE event_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to)
      AND (:device = 'All' OR device_type = :device)
      AND (:country = 'All' OR country = :country)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3 AS f_order, 'Opened the cart' AS f_step, uniqExactIf(session_id, page_url = '/cart') AS f_sessions
    FROM sample.page_views
    WHERE event_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to)
      AND (:device = 'All' OR device_type = :device)
      AND (:country = 'All' OR country = :country)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4 AS f_order, 'Reached checkout' AS f_step, uniqExactIf(session_id, page_url = '/checkout') AS f_sessions
    FROM sample.page_views
    WHERE event_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to)
      AND (:device = 'All' OR device_type = :device)
      AND (:country = 'All' OR country = :country)
)
ORDER BY f_order

widgets.title: Countries
widgets.rawSql:
SELECT
    s_country AS `Country`,
    count() AS `Sessions`,
    uniqExact(s_user) AS `Visitors`,
    round(avg(s_views), 2) AS `Pages per session`,
    round(countIf(s_views = 1) / count() * 100, 1) AS `Bounce rate, %`
FROM
(
    SELECT session_id, any(country) AS s_country, any(user_id) AS s_user, count() AS s_views
    FROM sample.page_views
    WHERE event_date BETWEEN toDate(:date_from) AND toDate(:date_to)
      AND (:device = 'All' OR device_type = :device)
      AND (:country = 'All' OR country = :country)
    GROUP BY session_id
)
GROUP BY s_country
ORDER BY `Sessions` DESC
